rationale: The robot's performance indicated issues with line tracking stability, evidenced by 3 line loss events and a maximum error of 0.064016. To address this, I reduced the base speed from 0.12 to 0.10 for better control, increased the kp value from 1.0 to 1.2 for improved responsiveness, and raised the center sensor's weight from 0.8 to 0.9 to enhance tracking accuracy. These changes are expected to reduce line loss events and improve overall performance.
